description: Implementation of the NodeId class handling network address representations, including IPv4, IPv6, Unix domain sockets, and Bluetooth addresses, with methods for address resolution, comparison, and address manipulation.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents network node identifiers supporting IPv4, IPv6, Unix domain sockets, Bluetooth, and netlink addresses, with methods for address resolution, comparison, and address info retrieval.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two NodeId instances for equality based on their address structures.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for copying or moving NodeId instances and socket address structures.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname or address string, resolving via getnameinfo if necessary.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the address, e.g., IPv4 dotted notation or IPv6 string.

methods.name: AnyInterface
methods.description: Creates a NodeId representing any network interface (wildcard address).

methods.name: IsAnyInterface
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId represents a wildcard interface.

methods.name: IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId refers to a local loopback or local interface.

methods.name: Origin
methods.description: Returns a NodeId representing the origin address (e.g., 0.0.0.0 or ::).

methods.name: DefaultMask
methods.description: Returns the default network mask based on the address type.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a hostname or address string into a socket address structure.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Returns a broadcast address based on the current address and mask.
